create_teacher_subclass: create a subclass of FixedDialogTeacher implementing setup_data to serve custom dialog data
create_dialog_teacher: create a DialogTeacher subclass with setup_data yielding message tuples for fixed chat logs
create_parlaidialogteacher: create a ParlAIDialogTeacher to load dialog data in ParlAI text format with labels and candidates
create_conversation_teacher: create a ConversationTeacher to load JSON conversation data with configurable label turns
create_chunk_teacher: create a ChunkTeacher subclass implementing load_from_chunk and create_message for large datasets
create_multitask_teacher: create a MultiTaskTeacher to combine multiple task agents with weighted random selection
create_image_teacher: create an AbstractImageTeacher subclass to serve image-text pairs with resnet features
use_dataloader: use DataLoader to submit background load requests for preloading images or large data
use_streamdialogdata: use StreamDialogData to stream dialog data that cannot fit entirely in memory
use_dialogdata: use DialogData to load and access fixed dialog data with episodes and label candidates
use_yaml_teacher: use YamlTeacher to load dialog data generated by AutoTeacherTest from YAML files
use_fbdialog_teacher: use FbDeprecatedDialogTeacher to parse Facebook dialog format data with rewards and candidates
use_create_task_agent: use create_task_agent_from_taskname to instantiate a teacher from a task string like babi:Task1k
override_get_method: override the get method in FixedDialogTeacher to return examples by episode and entry index
override_custom_evaluation: override custom_evaluation in FixedDialogTeacher to add dataset-specific metrics and evaluation
